finding.title: Sign-in redirects to any URL passed in returnTo
finding.explanation: /login stores `req.query.returnTo` in a cookie without checking it, and /auth/callback redirects to that cookie after a real sign-in. A link to https://shop.acme.com/login?returnTo=https://acme-shop.help/verify takes the customer through the genuine sign-in page and then to the attacker's site, which can ask them to re-enter their password or card. Browsers also treat //evil.example and /\evil.example as absolute.
finding.reasoningSummary: Followed returnTo from SignIn.tsx through the login cookie to res.redirect in the callback. Nothing on that path validates it. The repo already has safeRedirect() in src/server/http/safeRedirect.ts, used by logout and account settings, but not here.

evidence.text: GET /login?returnTo=https%3A%2F%2Facme-shop.help%2Fverify, then sign in with valid credentials: 302 Location: https://acme-shop.help/verify
